mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_MEMBERSHIP ( user_no, grade_code, grade_name, year_spent_amount, lifetime_spent_amount, created_date, updated_date ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{gradeCode}, CASE #{gradeCode} WHEN 'SEASAK' THEN '새싹단골' WHEN 'DANGOL' THEN '단골' WHEN 'DANGOL_VIP' THEN '단골VIP' WHEN 'DANGOL_FAMILY' THEN '단골패밀리' ELSE '새싹단골' END, 0, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT um.user_no AS userNo, um.grade_code AS gradeCode, um.grade_name AS gradeName, um.year_spent_amount AS yearSpentAmount, um.lifetime_spent_amount AS lifetimeSpentAmount, mg.discount_rate AS discountRate, mg.point_rate AS pointRate, mg.free_shipping_cnt AS freeShippingCnt FROM USER_MEMBERSHIP um JOIN MEMBERSHIP_GRADE mg ON um.grade_code = mg.grade_code WHERE um.user_no = #{userNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_MEMBERSHIP SET year_spent_amount = year_spent_amount + #{deltaAmount}, lifetime_spent_amount = lifetime_spent_amount + #{deltaAmount}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
UPDATE USER_MEMBERSHIP SET grade_code = #{gradeCode}, grade_name = #{gradeName}, last_grade_changed_at = SYSDATE, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE user_no = #{userNo}
